scope.image_classification: Only img src/srcset and CSS url() references are image-resource observations. Ordinary navigation/XML links are not images and are not emitted in image_links.
scope.redirect_handling: Record the observed redirect response and safely filtered Location as an un-followed edge. A redirect chain is marked incomplete because no additional request is made.
scope.current_origin_boundary: A successful HTTPS response is a current observation, not a historical capture, original-byte identity, or 2008-source claim.

policy.remaining_body_budget_rule: Before every curl GET, the body cap is min(4 MiB, remaining batch bytes, remaining bytes for that page). A direct failure and process-local proxy fallback share the same per-page and batch budgets.
policy.retry_after: Accept integer seconds or HTTP-date; cooldown is measured from the response end and is max(120 seconds, Retry-After).
